body:
Let me start off by telling you a little about myself. I am a 18 year old male who has done weed, ecstasy, and amphetamines. I have developed a high tolerance to both ecstasy and amphetamines over the years.
Thursday night at around 7:00 pm PST, I took 3 capsules of
phenibut and 1 Capsule of
[supplement] (main ingredient is 1,3 dimethylamine).
I didnt feel anything until about an hour and a half later, when I noticed euphoria, energy, talkativeness and an overall sense of greater well-being. This feeling plateaud and stayed constant until about 12 am. At which point I started feeling disoriented and noticed it was difficult for me to walk in a straight line.
When I got back home, I felt nauseous and woozy. This feeling persisted until about 2 am, when I threw up. After throwing up, I thought the shitty feelings had passed but they returned soon after. I ended up sitting in front of a trash can feeling nauseous and dizzy until about 6 am, when I took some diphenhydramine and was able to fall asleep at about 8 am.
The experience started off REALLY fun, much better than any amphetamine experience because I had no cotton mouth, didnt feel tweaky, and had an appetite but it became one of the shittiest experiences ever.
I dont know if I will try this combo again. If I do, I will probably try 1 capsule of phenibut with 1 capsule of the [DMAA-containing supplement] instead.
